name: mkdir
purpose: Make Directory — create one or more new folders directly from the terminal.
explanation: Creates a new directory. Supports brace expansion (e.g. mkdir folder_{1..1000}) to create many numbered folders in one command.

parameters.description: Creates nested parent/child directories in one go even if parent does not exist yet.

expectedOutput: (Creates 'practice' and 1000 folders named folder_1 through folder_1000)
whenToUse: When creating project folders or batch-creating multiple directories.
commonMistakes: Trying to create nested folders like parent/child without the -p flag.
